name: Specificational Copular Clause

1.definition: Identifies a value for a description made salient by the other copular expression.

examples.note: Constructed comparison. The reversed copular order identifies the same obstacle.

projection.target: The permit supplies a value rather than a general property. The reverse order can preserve the identification while changing the informational packaging.
projection.evidence: See the cited discussion and the constructed illustration.

curious.title: Sentences that fill in an answer
curious.summary: Some sentences with is set up a description and then name what fits it.
curious.body: The main obstacle is the permit. The phrase the main obstacle sets up a description, and the permit fills it in. It names which thing fits. This is different from a sentence that just says what something is like. You can reverse the order: The permit is the main obstacle. It still identifies the same obstacle, though the information is packaged differently. This dictionary marks the analysis as provisional.
curious.try: Complete The biggest problem is ... and then reverse it. What does each order put first?

teacher.summary: Helps explain be-clauses that identify a value for a description.
teacher.explain: A specificational copular clause pairs a variable NP with a value expression and be: it identifies a value for a description made salient by the other copular expression. In The main obstacle is the permit, the permit supplies a value rather than a general property. The reverse order, The permit is the main obstacle, can preserve the identification while changing the informational packaging. This dictionary treats the pattern as a specialization of the clause and relates it to pseudo-clefts and to subject-ascriptive clauses. The analysis is marked provisional.
teacher.terms: Compare ascriptive clauses, which ascribe a property. In this dictionary the related pattern is subject-ascriptive.

contrasts.text: The main obstacle is the permit.
contrasts.note: The variable comes first and the value second.

contrasts.text: The permit is the main obstacle.
contrasts.note: The reversed order identifies the same obstacle.

watch_for: A learner might read the permit as describing a property of the obstacle, when it supplies a value.
A learner might treat the reversed order as changing which obstacle is identified.
teacher.activity: Students write a description-then-value sentence (The winner is ...), reverse it, and say what each order puts first.

cite: Reynolds, Brett, ed. 2026. "Specificational Copular Clause." English Constructionary. https://brettreynolds.ca/constructionary/linguist/specificational-copular-001/ (snapshot 2026-11-19, ef810bb).
